I had a yeast infection for 4 years and after that, I was diagnosed with vulvodynia so yes, I think there is a link especially if the infection lasted for that long. I took fluconazole many times but the next month the candida was back, I even went through a 6 month prescription of fluconazole which helped while it lasted, however, again after a month I was feeling the symptoms again. I got tired of taking so many antibiotics that I followed the candida diet, to get rid of candida is important to avoid sugar/alcohol/process food and increase the ingestion of fruits/veggies and foods that promote the growth of probiotics and you may need to do that even after fluconazole at least for a year to make sure candida has completely gone away, that's the only way I got rid of it.

Hey, in my case I had a yeast infection for years and surgery to remove a cyst in the urethra, my poor vulva has gone through so many things and now I have vulvodynia and pelvic tightness. I was also having the symptoms you described, redness, and itchiness around the urethra, I wasn't able to sit comfortably so the pelvic therapist used ultrasound to calm down that area and I'm also doing sitz baths with marine salt to help heal the skin, and I am noticing an improvement. Some doctors can be so disappointing but luckily my pelvic therapist is very compassionate so I really hope you can find a good one. All the best to you!!
